caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a lace or embroidered fabric mask or pouch, centrally placed on a plain, light-colored background. The object is rendered in grayscale, with intricate details to indicate the texture and patterns of the material. The fabric features evenly spaced oval openings and floral or star-shaped embroidered motifs throughout its surface. The mask or pouch is shown slightly open, with visible folds and edges marked by narrow, bordered seams. There are four small loops, one at each corner, and a short fabric tab extending from the top right edge. The shading and stippling techniques are used to convey depth and the semi-transparency of the lace material. The name "SATTEL" appears printed or inscribed below the right side of the object.
title: Child's Cap
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
